svg.text: Disc 150 mm across, 6 mm thick; road side flat. The tray layout

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: picture gives every position from the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Locating ring: tapered, 141.4 mm across at the disc, 135.0 mm at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its top, 2.5 mm tall, 128 mm inside. It fits the dome's cavity

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cell cradles: two per cell, 11 x 5 mm, 4 mm tall, saddle-shaped,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 37 and 20 mm left of centre, 16 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board standoffs: four, 5 mm across, 3 mm tall, 1.6 mm pilot hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for M2 screws, at 5 and 35 mm right, 25 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Antenna rib: 2 x 50 mm, 8 mm tall; its inner face 48.5 mm right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes through the disc: fill 8 mm; four 4 mm vents (layout).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print disc down in an enclosed printer. Sand the road side with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 80 grit so the epoxy bed keys to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the dome drops over the ring and sits flat on the disc.
